title: Grocery delivery tools to explore
intro: Soft CTAs for established grocery-delivery patterns when you are modelling restaurant takeaway against supermarket delivery and meal-kit alternatives. Confirm postcode coverage, fees and minimums on each site — this block is not a ranking of delivery apps.
